Class MockMvcRequestBuilders

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders
public abstract class MockMvcRequestBuilders extends Object
Static factory methods for RequestBuilders.

与 Spring TestContext 框架集成

此类的 方法 将重用由 Spring TestContext Framework 创建的MockServletContext。

Eclipse 用户

考虑将此类添加为 Java 编辑器收藏夹。要导航到该设置，请打开首选项并输入"favorites"。

Since:
3.2
Author:
Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev, Greg Turnquist, Sebastien Deleuze, Sam Brannen, Kamill Sokol

    • asyncDispatch

      public static RequestBuilder asyncDispatch(MvcResult mvcResult)
      Create a RequestBuilder for an async dispatch from the MvcResult of the request that started async processing.

      使用首先执行一个启动异步处理的请求：

      MvcResult mvcResult = this.mockMvc.perform(get("/1"))
.andExpect(request().asyncStarted())
.andReturn();

      然后执行异步分发，重用MvcResult：

      this.mockMvc.perform(asyncDispatch(mvcResult))
        .andExpect(status().isOk())
        .andExpect(content().contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON))
        .andExpect(content().string("{\"name\":\"Joe\",\"someDouble\":0.0,\"someBoolean\":false}"));
      Parameters:
      mvcResult - 启动异步处理请求的结果
